tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Find a country, region or "world" destination by name or ISO code. Returns destination codes for list_plans (country: ISO2 like "JP"; region: like "R-EUROPE"; world: "WORLD"), starting prices in USD, and how many data and phone-number plans exist. An empty query lists all destinations.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List purchasable plans for a destination, cheapest first. type "data" = data-only eSIM: validity starts on first connection at the destination. type "number" = eSIM with a phone number, calls and SMS: validity starts at installation, so install it just before use; Europe plans give a French +33 numb

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Full details of one plan: all covered countries, data, days, phone number (if any), install rules, when validity starts, and notes. Read the notes to the person before create_order.

tools.name: list_payment_coins
tools.description: Coins and networks accepted for payment. Pass coin and network to create_order. Sending on a different network loses the funds.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a crypto invoice for one new eSIM. Before calling, confirm the plan with the person and tell them when validity starts and the plan notes (number plans: validity starts at installation; Europe number is French +33; UK number plan: install only after arrival). Returns order_id, order_token, th

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Order status: pending (waiting for payment), paid (issuing), delivered, expired, failed. When delivered, returns for each eSIM: QR code (also as an image), LPA activation code, ICCID, and one-tap iOS/Android install links. Call at most once every 5 seconds.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an unpaid order the person decided not to pay. Do not cancel after the payment was sent.

tools.name: list_topups
tools.description: Check whether an installed Cypher eSIM can be topped up and list the plans that can be added to it.

tools.name: create_topup
tools.description: Create a crypto invoice that adds a data plan to an existing eSIM (no new QR, nothing to install). plan_id must come from list_topups for this ICCID. Payment and polling work exactly like create_order.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a crypto invoice for one new eSIM. Before calling, confirm the plan with the person and tell them when validity starts and the plan notes (number plans: …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
